messages.author: 278fb6e968fd5c41
messages.subject: scanone with permutations error message
parts:
hi,

I'm trying to run the permutations function on a qtl object and get
the following error message.

sex <- data.$pheno[,2]
> out.data <- scanone(data, pheno.col=c(5:39), intcovar=sex, method="mr", n.perm=1000, perm.Xsp=TRUE)
--Autosome permutations
Error in intcovarp[o, , drop = FALSE] : incorrect number of dimensions


I have been able to get results when I don't run the permutations as
well as when I don't use the covariate. But when I tried to run 3 or
more traits simultaneously, it gave me the above error message.

I've also been able to run scanone with covariates and the
permutations function on another datafile, and it works fine. Not
sure whats going on.

Thanks so much,
e

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] scanone with permutations error message
parts:
I found the bug. A fix will be incorporated in the next version of R/
qtl.
For now, I would suggest first dropping individuals with missing
covariates
prior to the permutations.

karl
